facts.fact: Le Tech Observateur reports that the digital ministry closed a public consultation in August 2024 for Senegal's Digital Strategy 2025-2035, is analysing the contributions, and promised to unveil the strategy by the end of August 2024.

Le Tech Observateur reports that the digital ministry's public consultation on the 2025-2035 digital strategy, opened on 25 July 2024, drew more than 700 contributions on the dedicated Jubbanti platform.

Le Tech Observateur reports that the digital ministry ran a national public consultation on the Digital Strategy 2025-2035 from 25 July 2024, with more than 700 contributions from the public submitted on the Jubbanti platform.
